title: Data of an observations event (TELEMETRY.md section 3)
description: One received packet as the radio heard it, before parsing. raw is the packet's bytes in hex (the mesh's own ciphertext: nothing is decrypted). dropped counts the packets not sent since the previous event (over the stream's rate, or while the transport could not take one).

type.description: payload type, read from the first byte of the frame

route.description: route type, read from the first byte; t = with transport codes

path_len.description: hops recorded in the path; null when the frame ends before its path-length byte or uses the reserved mode
